opportunities.title: Render blocking requests
opportunities.description: Requests are blocking the page's initial render, which may delay LCP. [Deferring or inlining](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/performance/insights/render-blocking) can move these network requests out of the critical path.

opportunities.title: Lists do not contain only `<li>` elements and script supporting elements (`<script>` and `<template>`).
opportunities.description: Screen readers have a specific way of announcing lists. Ensuring proper list structure aids screen reader output. [Learn more about proper list structure](https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.11/list).

opportunities.title: Page is blocked from indexing
opportunities.description: Search engines are unable to include your pages in search results if they don't have permission to crawl them. [Learn more about crawler directives](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/seo/is-crawlable/).

opportunities.title: Definition list items are not wrapped in `<dl>` elements
opportunities.description: Definition list items (`<dt>` and `<dd>`) must be wrapped in a parent `<dl>` element to ensure that screen readers can properly announce them. [Learn how to structure definition lists correctly](https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.11/dlitem).

opportunities.title: Background and foreground colors do not have a sufficient contrast ratio.
opportunities.description: Low-contrast text is difficult or impossible for many users to read. [Learn how to provide sufficient color contrast](https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.11/color-contrast).

opportunities.title: Heading elements are not in a sequentially-descending order
opportunities.description: Properly ordered headings that do not skip levels convey the semantic structure of the page, making it easier to navigate and understand when using assistive technologies. [Learn more about heading order](https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.11/heading-order).

opportunities.title: Uses deprecated APIs
opportunities.description: Deprecated APIs will eventually be removed from the browser. [Learn more about deprecated APIs](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/best-practices/deprecations/).

opportunities.title: `<td>` elements in a large `<table>` do not have table headers.
opportunities.description: Screen readers have features to make navigating tables easier. Ensuring that `<td>` elements in a large table (3 or more cells in width and height) have an associated table header may improve the experience for screen reader users. [Learn more about table headers](https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.11/td-has-header).
